name: echarts
title: Apache ECharts
responsibility: Advanced data visualization — complex, highly configurable charts at scale (canvas-rendered). The heavyweight for datasets the React-tier charting cannot carry.
reachFor: Config-driven rendering where React re-render cost matters
avoid: Loading the full bundle — import only needed charts/components from echarts/core
reactWiring: echarts.init(el) in an effect; setOption on data changes; dispose() on unmount; resize via ResizeObserver
